h: NCDC says Nigeria has one confirmed Ebola case as contact tracing continues
p: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control says one confirmed Ebola case remains in the country, alongside two suspected cases. Dozens of contacts of the patient, who reportedly travelled from Uganda, have been identified and are being monitored. Authorities urge the public to rely on official updates. The WHO has separately said Nigeria currently has no active Ebola cases, while health authorities have approved a weekly N100,000 stipend for contacts under monitoring.
more: A toll-free line, 6232, is open for reporting suspected cases.
Several states, including Zamfara, have stepped up airport and motor-park screening.
Contacts under monitoring are due weekly allowances, the agency has said.
